correctness.rationale: For arbitrary \(q=3^m\), the smoothness criterion is proved by a quadratic matrix and principal minors. The full Hasse--Witt matrix is reconstructed, not estimated, and its diagonal entries have stable Frobenius ranks equal to the number of nonzero entries. Character sums exactly count the two excluded square conditions and their intersection; inclusion--exclusion yields the smooth total. Counts T1, T2, T3 for prescribed Hasse--Witt zero sets give all rank strata. An independent stdlib-only program checks all coefficients over \(\mathbb F_3\) and \(\mathbb F_9\). The finite test is not substituted for the all-field proof.

value.rationale: The naturally defined six-term Ciani system supports a full Jacobian \(p\)-rank stratification. The exact characteristic-three counts for every extension field are a genuine arithmetic refinement beyond smoothness or superspecial existence, and the absence of any ordinary smooth marked equation over \(\mathbb F_3\) is a meaningful boundary. The proof requires nontrivial character sums, pairwise divisor intersections and Frobenius stability; the results are not arbitrary coefficient slices or known-table recomputations.
